mapper.select: SELECT stat_month, AS report_month, MAX(updated_at) AS updated_at FROM `date-project`.dws_inventory_report_department_summary WHERE is_total = 0 GROUP BY stat_month ORDER BY stat_month DESC

SELECT stat_month, AS report_month, department_code, department_name, display_order, COALESCE(local_end_in_transit_total_cost, 0) AS local_in_transit_cost, COALESCE(local_end_inventory_total_cost, 0) AS local_inventory_cost, COALESCE(overseas_end_in_transit_total_cost, 0) + COALESCE(fba_end_in_transit_total_cost, 0) AS overseas_fba_in_transit_cost, COALESCE(overseas_end_inventory_total_cost, 0) + COALESCE(fba_end_inventory_total_cost, 0) AS overseas_fba_inventory_cost FROM `date-project`.dws_inventory_report_department_summary WHERE is_total = 0 AND LIKE CONCAT(#{year}, '-%')
AND = CONCAT(#{year}, '-', #{month})
ORDER BY report_month, display_order, id
